The dataset "subset_white_final_IB.Rdata" contains all RAW variables needed for IB mediations (**before** transformations and stress categories creation), but after the imputation and after removing individuals with diseases (see previous step).


```{r}
load("../data/subset_white_final_IB.Rdata")
st_categ <- read.csv("../data/stress_categories.csv") ## theory-driven categories
library(dplyr)
```

stressors

# 2) List of IBs:

# Ensure covariates sex and physical activity are factors:

str(subset_white_final_IB$C1SA26F)

```{r}
# Check distribution of IB raw data:
for (IB in IBs) {
  hist(subset_white_final_IB[[IB]], main = paste(IB))
}
```

Both, residuals (IB ~ stress) and raw IBs data are skewed. I will transform all IBs:

### - IBs transformation:

```{r}
# Apply inverse-normal transformation to all IBs:
for (IB in IBs) {
  subset_white_final_IB[[IB]] <- qnorm((rank(subset_white_final_IB[[IB]], na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_IB[[IB]])))
}

head(subset_white_final_IB[, IBs])
```


### - Regressions (descriptive only):

#### - CF ~ individual_stressors

```{r}
# Define all Cognitive Function (CF) variables by model type:
CFs_linear_no_transform <- c("C3TCTFLU", "C3TEF")
CFs_linear_to_transform <- c("C3TBKTOT", "C3TEM")
CFs_poisson_individual  <- c("C3TWLITU", "C3TDBS", "C3TNSTOT")
# NOTE: C3TSCGBA intentionally excluded from this table - opposite polarity (latency/cost measure)

# Sanity check: composites should correlate positively with their component tests
cor(subset_white_final_IB$C3TEF, subset_white_final_IB$C3TCTFLU, use = "complete.obs")
cor(subset_white_final_IB$C3TEM, subset_white_final_IB$C3TWLITU, use = "complete.obs")

# Apply inverse-normal transformation to the CFs that needed it:
inverse_normal_transform <- function(x) {
  qnorm((rank(x, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)))
}

for (CF in CFs_linear_to_transform) {
  subset_white_final_IB[[paste0(CF, "_trans")]] <- inverse_normal_transform(subset_white_final_IB[[CF]])
}

CFs_linear_individual <- c(
  CFs_linear_no_transform,
  paste0(CFs_linear_to_transform, "_trans")
)

CF_model_key <- data.frame(
  CF = c(CFs_linear_individual, CFs_poisson_individual),
  CF_original = c(
    CFs_linear_no_transform,
    CFs_linear_to_transform,
    CFs_poisson_individual
  ),
  Model = c(
    rep("gaussian_identity", length(CFs_linear_individual)),
    rep("poisson_log", length(CFs_poisson_individual))
  ),
  Transformation = c(
    rep("none", length(CFs_linear_no_transform)),
    rep("inverse_normal", length(CFs_linear_to_transform)),
    rep("none", length(CFs_poisson_individual))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

CF_model_key
```

```{r}
# Perform the regressions (CF ~ individual_stressors) and collect betas and p-values
# (DESCRIPTIVE ONLY ):

extract_cf_stressor_betas <- function(stress_vars, cf_vars, data, model_family, model_label) {
  results <- data.frame(CF = character(),
                        Variable = character(),
                        Term = character(),
                        Beta = numeric(),
                        Pvalue = numeric(),
                        Model = character(),
                        Link = character(),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  for (cf in cf_vars) {
    for (st in stress_vars) {
      formula <- as.formula(paste(cf, "~", st, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI + C1SA26F + C1SA11T"))
      model <- glm(formula, family = model_family, data = data)
      coeffs <- summary(model)$coefficients

      stress_terms <- rownames(coeffs) == st
      if (!any(stress_terms)) {
        stress_terms <- startsWith(rownames(coeffs), st)
      }

      if (any(stress_terms)) {
        term_names <- rownames(coeffs)[stress_terms]
        result_rows <- data.frame(CF = cf,
                                  Variable = st,
                                  Term = term_names,
                                  Beta = coeffs[stress_terms, 1],
                                  Pvalue = coeffs[stress_terms, 4],
                                  Model = model_label,
                                  Link = model_family$link,
                                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
        results <- rbind(results, result_rows)
      }
    }
  }

  return(results)
}

results_ST_CFs_linear <- extract_cf_stressor_betas(
  stress_vars = stressors,
  cf_vars = CFs_linear_individual,
  data = subset_white_final_IB,
  model_family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  model_label = "gaussian_identity"
)

results_ST_CFs_poisson <- extract_cf_stressor_betas(
  stress_vars = stressors,
  cf_vars = CFs_poisson_individual,
  data = subset_white_final_IB,
  model_family = poisson(link = "log"),
  model_label = "poisson_log"
)

results_ST_CFs <- rbind(results_ST_CFs_linear, results_ST_CFs_poisson)

results_ST_CFs <- merge(results_ST_CFs, CF_model_key, by = c("CF", "Model"), all.x = TRUE)

results_ST_CFs <- results_ST_CFs %>%
  dplyr::select(CF_original, CF, Transformation, Model, Link, Variable, Term, Beta, Pvalue)

str(results_ST_CFs)
head(results_ST_CFs)
```

# 2) Dichotomization and grouping by stressor categories:


```{r}
# Make a copy of the dataset before creating category-level stress scores.
subset_white_final_IB_dic <- subset_white_final_IB


# Use ALL stressors listed in stress_categories.csv (a priori classification)
selected_stressor_info <- st_categ %>%
  filter(Variable %in% stressors) %>%   # restrict to stressors present in this dataset
  distinct(Variable, category, value_range) %>%
  arrange(category, Variable)

# Sanity check: flag any stressor in the dataset that has no category assigned in stress_categories.csv (these would silently be dropped otherwise).
unclassified_stressors <- setdiff(stressors, selected_stressor_info$Variable)
if (length(unclassified_stressors) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING: the following stressors have no category in stress_categories.csv and will NOT be included in any category score:\n")
  print(unclassified_stressors)
}

missing_ranges <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  filter(is.na(value_range) | value_range == "" | value_range == "NA")
if (nrow(missing_ranges) > 0) {
  stop("These stressors have missing value_range metadata: ",
       paste(missing_ranges$Variable, collapse = ", "))
}

make_score_name <- function(category_name) {
  score_name <- tolower(category_name)
  score_name <- gsub("\\s*-\\s*", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("_+", "_", score_name)
  score_name <- gsub("^_|_$", "", score_name)
  paste0(score_name, "_score")
}

transform_by_value_range <- function(x, value_range) {
  range_parts <- strsplit(value_range, "to", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(range_parts) != 2) {
    stop("Unsupported value_range format: ", value_range)
  }

  min_value <- as.numeric(range_parts[1])
  max_value <- as.numeric(range_parts[2])
  if (is.na(min_value) || is.na(max_value)) {
    stop("Unsupported value_range format: ", value_range)
  }

  high_stress_cutoff <- floor((min_value + max_value) / 2) + 1
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_integer_, ifelse(x >= high_stress_cutoff, 1L, 0L))
}

category_score_key <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  distinct(category) %>%
  mutate(score_var = make_score_name(category))

for (current_category in category_score_key$category) {
  category_vars <- selected_stressor_info %>%
    filter(category == current_category)

  missing_dataset_vars <- setdiff(category_vars$Variable, names(subset_white_final_IB_dic))
  if (length(missing_dataset_vars) > 0) {
    stop("These stressors are missing from subset_white_final_IB: ",
         paste(missing_dataset_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }

  transformed_matrix <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(category_vars)), function(i) {
    current_var <- category_vars$Variable[i]
    current_range <- category_vars$value_range[i]
    transform_by_value_range(subset_white_final_IB_dic[[current_var]], current_range)
  })

  if (is.null(dim(transformed_matrix))) {
    transformed_matrix <- matrix(transformed_matrix, ncol = 1)
  }
  colnames(transformed_matrix) <- category_vars$Variable

  score_var <- category_score_key$score_var[category_score_key$category == current_category]
  subset_white_final_IB_dic[[score_var]] <- rowSums(transformed_matrix, na.rm = FALSE)
}

stressors_cat <- category_score_key$score_var

selected_stressor_info
category_score_key
lapply(stressors_cat, function(x) table(subset_white_final_IB_dic[[x]], useNA = "ifany"))

# Diagnostic: complete-case N per category score, to flag power loss from NA propagation
cat("\nComplete-case N per category score (rowSums with na.rm = FALSE propagates NA):\n")
for (score_var in stressors_cat) {
  cat(" -", score_var, ":", sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_IB_dic[[score_var]])),
      "/", nrow(subset_white_final_IB_dic), "\n")
}

```

```{r}
category_score_summary <- selected_stressor_info %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    score_var = make_score_name(first(category)),
    n_variables = n(),
    variables = paste(Variable, collapse = ", "),
    original_value_ranges = paste(unique(value_range), collapse = ", "),
    dichotomized_variable_range = "0to1",
    category_score_possible_range = paste0("0to", n_variables),
    category_score_observed_range = paste0(
      min(subset_white_final_IB_dic[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      "to",
      max(subset_white_final_IB_dic[[score_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(score_var, stressors_cat))

category_score_summary
```


# 3) Diagnostics (models used in mediation):

Run model diagnostics for the 2 models included in the mediations:
- Model_M = IB ~ Stressor (category)
- Model_Y = CF ~ Stressor (category) + IB

### - Model_M = IB ~ Stressor(category):

```{r}
stressors_cat <- category_score_key$score_var

pdf("../outs/IB_diagnostics_model_M.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

for (IB in IBs) {
  for (stress in stressors_cat) {
    model <- glm(as.formula(paste(IB, "~", stress, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                   family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
                   data = subset_white_final_IB_dic)

    par(mfrow = c(2,3))
    invisible(capture.output({
      plot(model, main = paste("Model:", IB, "~", stress))
      hist(residuals(model), main = paste("Model:", IB, "~", stress))
    }))
  }
}

dev.off()
```

All residuals of the Model_M seem to be ok.

### - Model_Y = CF ~ Stressor(category) + IB:

##### Linear models:

```{r}
# List the CF with quantitative data (C3TSCGBA excluded per polarity note above):
CFs_linear <- c("C3TCTFLU", "C3TBKTOT", "C3TEM", "C3TEF")

pdf("../outs/IB_diagnostics_model_Y_linear.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

for (CF in CFs_linear) {
  for (IB in IBs) {
    for (stress in stressors_cat) {
      model_Y <- glm(as.formula(paste(CF, "~", stress, "+", IB, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")), family = gaussian(link = "identity"),  data = subset_white_final_IB_dic)

      par(mfrow = c(2,3))
      invisible(capture.output({
        plot(model_Y, main = paste("Model:", CF, "~", stress, "+", IB))
        hist(residuals(model_Y), main = paste("Model:", CF, "~", stress, "+", IB))
      }))
    }
  }
}
dev.off()
```

Residuals of models using C3TBKTOT and C3TEM are skewed. I will transform them:

```{r}
subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TBKTOT_trans <- qnorm((rank(subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TBKTOT, na.last = "keep")-0.5)/ sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TBKTOT)))
subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TEM_trans <- qnorm((rank(subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TEM, na.last = "keep")-0.5)/ sum(!is.na(subset_white_final_IB_dic$C3TEM)))

head(subset_white_final_IB_dic[, c("C3TBKTOT", "C3TBKTOT_trans", "C3TEM", "C3TEM_trans")])
```

```{r}
pdf("../outs/IB_diagnostics_model_Y_linear_CFstransf.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

CFs_linear_t <- c("C3TCTFLU", "C3TBKTOT_trans", "C3TEM_trans", "C3TEF")

for (CF in CFs_linear_t) {
  for (IB in IBs) {
    for (stress in stressors_cat) {
      model_Y <- glm(as.formula(paste(CF, "~", stress, "+", IB, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                     family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
                     data = subset_white_final_IB_dic)

      par(mfrow = c(2,3))
      invisible(capture.output({
        plot(model_Y, main = paste("Model:", CF, "~", stress, "+", IB))
        hist(residuals(model_Y), main = paste("Model:", CF, "~", stress, "+", IB))
      }))
    }
  }
}
dev.off()
```

Residuals are ok after transformation.

##### Poisson models:

```{r}
library(performance)

CFs_poisson <- c("C3TWLITU", "C3TDBS", "C3TNSTOT")

for (CF in CFs_poisson) {
  for (IB in IBs) {
    for (stress in stressors_cat) {
      model_Y <- glm(as.formula(paste(CF, "~", stress, "+", IB, "+ C1PRSEX + C1PRAGE + SES + C1SBMI   + C1SA26F + C1SA11T")),
                     family = poisson(link = "log"),
                     data = subset_white_final_IB_dic)
      overdispersion_result <- check_overdispersion(model_Y)
      print(paste("Model:", CF, "~", stress, "+", IB))
      print(overdispersion_result)
    }
  }
}
```

No overdispersion was detected for any model.
